newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to allow labour pension funds in OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to allow labour pension funds in OTC market.

text.p: A panel of the cabinet's Council for Labour Affairs said on Thursday it would allow state labour pension funds to invest in Taiwan's fledgling over-the-counter market and initial public offering shares.

"We plan to ease rules to allow the labour pension fund more flexible operation to expand its current investment in the (main) stock exchange to the OTC market and IPO shares," a labour council official told Reuters.
She said the proposal needed approval by the full labour council as well as the cabinet to be effective. The council supervises the huge labour fund's operation.
According to its rules, up to 30 percent of the fund can be invested in stocks.
As of end-February, the fund was worth T$112 billion (US$4.07 billion), meaning its stock investment could reach as high as T$33.6 billion, the official said.
"As of end-February, (the fund) had invested only T$9.4 billion in stocks," she said.
